SELECT DISTINCT dd.code AS disposition, m.label AS wg_meeting, p.pack_number AS cr_pack, p.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting, s.clause AS clause
FROM document d
JOIN disposition dd ON dd.target = d.id
  AND dd.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
  AND dd.scope = 'whole_target'
JOIN resolution r ON r.id = dd.resolution_id
JOIN meeting m ON m.id = r.meeting_id AND m.wg = 'RAN1'
JOIN cr_in_pack cp ON cp.cr = d.id
JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = cp.pack_id
JOIN cr_modifies_section cs ON cs.cr = d.id
JOIN section s ON s.id = cs.section_id
WHERE d.number = 'R1-1913654' AND s.spec IN ('38.213', 'TS 38.213')

WITH current_clauses AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.number AS document, s.spec, s.release, s.clause, p.tsg_number
  FROM document d
  JOIN cr_in_pack cp ON cp.cr = d.id
JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = cp.pack_id
  JOIN disposition dd ON dd.target = d.id
  AND dd.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
  AND dd.scope = 'whole_target'
JOIN resolution r ON r.id = dd.resolution_id
JOIN meeting m ON m.id = r.meeting_id AND m.wg = 'RAN1'
  JOIN cr_modifies_section cs ON cs.cr = d.id
JOIN section s ON s.id = cs.section_id
  WHERE p.pack_number = 'RP-192634' AND s.release = d.target_release
    AND d.target_release IN ('Rel-16')
)
SELECT DISTINCT current.document AS document, current.spec AS specification, current.clause AS clause
FROM current_clauses current
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM section old_s
  JOIN cr_modifies_section old_cs ON old_cs.section_id = old_s.id
  JOIN document old_d ON old_d.id = old_cs.cr AND old_d.target_release = current.release
  JOIN cr_in_pack old_cp ON old_cp.cr = old_d.id
  JOIN cr_pack old_p ON old_p.id = old_cp.pack_id
  WHERE old_s.spec = current.spec AND old_s.release = current.release
    AND old_s.clause = current.clause AND old_p.tsg_number < current.tsg_number
)
